thread:
Maya: FYI legal just emailed with a checklist from an EU bank for BYOK/HSM onboarding. They want signed attestation bundles, proof-of-origin, and long-term retention for evidence. Question: can we scope anyone who does attestation so they never touch raw key material?

Arjun: Yes. Design idea: attestation agents run in the customer's tenant boundary. Flow: HSM -> tenant-side attester -> signed cert returned. That way our control plane never receives key material. Need a new role 'attester' bound to tenant-scoped tokens.

Liz: UX requirements: per-tenant listing in Console, explicit consent checkbox, downloadable signed bundle link, and clear note about retention length. Also show a small badge if artifacts are exported off-EU.

Carmine: Ops/IR considerations: define three playbooks: 1) attestation verification fail, 2) suspected key compromise, 3) audit-log-gap. If customer subscribes to SIEM forwarding, we still keep redundant WORM copies for 90 days (per current EU guidance) — legal to confirm min.

Tom: Legal follow-up: bank demands certain custody evidence kept for 7 years for audit. They also want a contract clause that we will only provide escrow with court order. Can infra make retention tenant-configurable but with a company max cap?

Arjun: Implementation plan: retention is tenant-configurable up to a global cap (e.g., 7 years). Logs and attestation blobs must be tenant-partitioned and signed at write-time (HMAC or KMS-signed index) for tamper evidence. Add a retention_policy tag on objects.

Maya: RBAC delta request: propose roles below; ensure no role permits decrypt for BYOK keys.
- role:attester (read: tenant-hsm-metadata, write: attestation-cert)
- role:auditor (read: attestation-cert, read: audit-logs)
- role:operator (admin on infra but NO kms:Decrypt for BYOK)
Can infra draft IAM policies that enforce tenant==principal.

Arjun: Pseudo-policy for review:
```
allow {
  principal.role == "attester" && resource.tenant == principal.tenant
  actions == ["read:hsm-metadata","write:attestation-cert"]
}
```

Liz: Console UX: warn on retention > 1yr, require compliance contact + legal approval checkbox. Provide a one-click download of the signed attestation bundle and an option to encrypt it with customer's public key before it leaves their boundary.

Carmine: Rotation handling: if customer rotates keys inside their HSM, we must invalidate cached attestations and re-run attestation. Default attestation cache TTL 30d, force re-attest on webhook from tenant HSM adapter. Add test cases that simulate rotation and missing audit entries.

Arjun: We'll implement attestation cache per tenant with TTL and a tenant-facing webhook endpoint. Also emit an event to the signed index so audits can prove the sequence of attestations (HMAC chain). Integration test will verify index chain integrity.

Maya: Logging pipeline: store immutable audit blobs (WORM) and a signed index. Offer streaming to customer endpoints (S3, SIEM) and an option to encrypt bundles with customer's CMK or public key before export.

Tom: Cross-border: confirm whether attestation blobs or logs will leave EU. If they do, we need SCCs/DPA updates and explicit transfer controls documented. Add transfer flag in metadata.

Arjun: If customer wants artifacts stored encrypted by their KMS, we can accept an encrypted upload or encrypt on-the-fly with their public key. That ensures unreadable artifacts in our storage.

ops-bot: Deployment checklist created: https://redwood.internal/wiki/attestation-onboard-checklist — include tenant retention config, RBAC roles, attestation webhook, WORM store, signed index, rotation webhook. :white_check_mark:

Carmine: IR test addition: simulate delayed write to audit store to trigger fallback copy and ensure missing-entry alerting fires. Add escalation page for legal if retention policy requests exceed company cap.

Arjun: Notedwill add unit/integration tests: HMAC chain verification, tenant-bound role tests, webhook-triggered re-attest.

Maya: Next steps: Arjun to open RBAC PR with policy tests, Carmine to author incident-playbook sections for the three scenarios, Liz to wire console flows and the download/encrypt option, Tom to confirm retention minima with legal. Schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow to consolidate. Target internal review by EOW. :+1:
